description: Sends a traveller's first message to a home's host through CielStay: questions, dates and party, a request to book, or a monthly or long-stay inquiry. Free. guestEmail must be the traveller's own address: the host's reply goes there. Usually the message is sent at once (status "sent") and the traveller gets a "Sent" email with a link to the conversation; if the address already has a CielStay account, status is "awaiting_guest_confirmation" and the traveller confirms from an email link. The reply's `next` says what happens next. Available for homes that carry messageHostUrl: hostReach in the reply is "host" (the host manages the home on CielStay) or "possible_contact" (the message is emailed to the contact published on this home's booking site, who may not be the host and may not answer). For any other home it is refused with hostReach "none", and bookUrl is the way to the host. CielStay never takes bookings or payments; the host replies with their terms. Takes the id from search_vacation_rentals or get_listing_details. messageHostUrl is the same form for the traveller to send.

guestEmail.description: The traveller's own email address: the host's reply comes there

message.description: The message to the host, in the traveller's words: who is coming, why, and any questions
